description: This file defines the EmailService class responsible for handling email operations in the OrangeHRM system, including configuration, sending emails, templating, and queuing email notifications. It interacts with external classes and services such as Mailer, EmailDao, EmailConfigurationService, and EmailQueueService.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Class responsible for managing email configurations, composing, sending, queuing, and templating within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: getEmailDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmailDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmailQueueService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmailQueueService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getSendmailPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the sendmail executable.

methods.name: setSendmailPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the sendmail executable.

methods.name: isConfigSet
methods.description: Checks if email configuration is properly set.

methods.name: setConfigSet
methods.description: Sets the configuration status.

methods.name: getEmailConfig
methods.description: Returns the current EmailConfiguration object.

methods.name: setMessageSubject
methods.description: Sets the subject line of the email message.

methods.name: setMessageFrom
methods.description: Sets the 'from' address of the email message.

methods.name: setMessageTo
methods.description: Sets the recipient addresses of the email message.

methods.name: setMessageBody
methods.description: Sets the body content of the email message.

methods.name: setMessageCc
methods.description: Sets the CC recipients of the email message.

methods.name: setMessageBcc
methods.description: Sets the BCC recipients of the email message.

methods.name: loadConfiguration
methods.description: Loads email configuration from the database and system settings.

methods.name: setEmailConfig
methods.description: Assigns an EmailConfiguration object to the service.

methods.name: getEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmailConfigurationService.

methods.name: setEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Sets the EmailConfigurationService instance.

methods.name: getMailer
methods.description: Creates and returns a Mailer object for sending emails.

methods.name: getTransport
methods.description: Creates and returns a MailTransport object based on current configuration.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Constructs and returns a MailMessage object with current message details.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends the email using the configured Mailer and message. Returns success status.

methods.name: sendTestEmail
methods.description: Sends a test email to verify SMTP/configuration correctness.

methods.name: validateEmailAddress
methods.description: Validates an email address format.

methods.name: areRecipientAddressesValid
methods.description: Validates all recipient email addresses.

methods.name: logResult
methods.description: Logs the outcome of email operations.

methods.name: queueEmailNotifications
methods.description: Queues email notifications for roles based on event data, with caching to prevent spamming.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateBestMatch
methods.description: Retrieves the best matching email template based on locale, recipient, and performer roles.

methods.name: queueEmailNotification
methods.description: Queues individual email notifications based on template and recipient details.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads and returns the content of a file given its relative path in the plugin directory.
